HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of The Enlightened Beings? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Enlightened Beings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say The Enlightened Beings has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Enlightened Beings.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Names of Scriptures? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Names of Scriptures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Names of Scriptures to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Names of Scriptures has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Names of Scriptures.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

4. Which response best shows understanding of Places of Worship? (1 mark)
   A. Say Places of Worship has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Places of Worship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Places of Worship.
   D. Apply the teaching of Places of Worship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Myself? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Myself.
   B. Say Myself has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Myself with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Myself to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Simple postures? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Simple postures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Simple postures to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Simple postures.
   D. Say Simple postures has no place in daily life.

7. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

8. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette.
   B. Say General Etiquette has no place in daily life.
   C. Use General Etiquette to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Names of Scriptures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Simple postures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain General Etiquette and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
